How I Work

A little about my approach, experience, and how I work with teams.

I can take a task from understanding the requirements to reviewing the final interface. I've worked on complex B2B platforms, CRMs, dashboards, and data-heavy interfaces. I'm comfortable designing from scratch or improving existing products.

I can work through a task on my own, gather missing information, explore different solutions, and prepare designs for development. I also stay in touch with the team, discuss constraints, and share progress along the way.

I start by understanding the problem and who I'm solving it for. I look at user flows, product data, research findings, and feedback. I don't stick to my first idea if I find a better way to solve the problem.

I use user interviews, usability testing, product analytics, and feedback to check whether a solution works. I also review the implemented interface and make adjustments when something doesn't work as expected.

I work directly with product managers, analysts, developers, and clients. We discuss requirements, explore solutions, and work through technical constraints. I stay involved during development, answer questions, and review the final implementation.

A lot of my work involves products that already have established interfaces, workflows, and design systems. I first understand how everything works, then figure out what actually needs changing. I don't see a reason to redesign everything when a smaller change can solve the problem.

I've worked on B2B SaaS, CRMs, fintech, logistics, e-commerce, and mobile apps. Figma is my main design tool, including components, variables, and prototyping. I also use ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex to explore ideas, solve problems, and build interactive prototypes.
